name: Ciel Blanchette
source:
Occupation: Field Agent
Notable Traits: Inexperienced, superiority complex

A girl who suddenly barges into Arthur's life and surprisingly possesses a lot of sensitive information and intelligent prowess.

The upstart rookie trying to prove her worth to her mentor. Highly intelligent and cunning, she leads Julie and Arthur in their mission to find the leader of The Syndicate.

[Spoiler]Her real name is Jacqueline Portman.[/Spoiler]

[Edited from [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/716330/VOID/]Steam[/url] and [url=http://void.vifthfloor.moe/img/ciel.png]Character Profile[/url]]
